_comment: Post-search steps from the two-edge search (spinel_edges.json, seed 56) to the published Pi_V and Pi_C (edges finalize). Keys starting with '_' are notes. Entries marked 'author decision' were chosen by the authors over the automatic result.

selection._comment: Numerically safe formulas of the hall of fame; near-optimal = within auc_delta of the best safe AUC; the path AUC is a gate only.

pruning._comment: Single-node deletions, beam of the 96 simplest survivors, six rounds; guards against the seed.

coefficients._comment: Grid of simple fractions, then a dense grid around the 10 best; the simplest fractions within near_auc[0] (else near_auc[1]) of the best AUC whose margin agreement is at most max_margin_loss below the balanced champion are recommended.

freeze.description: Published spinel edge-resolved coordinates (SI Note 7, Eq. sr-7). Pi_S enters with protected-ratio regularizers fitted on the 440 development states and is divided by its development IQR; the outer ratios use 1e-6 x the development upper quartile of the denominator; the margin agreement uses tie-averaged ranks.

V.name: Pi_V

seed._why: The simplest near-optimal safe formula of the selection.

structure._why: author decision: the pruning recommends Pi_S + 3 A_theta d_A - D_BXB/C_XX^2 (4 descriptors, AUC 0.888); the authors kept the 6-descriptor member of the pruning set with AUC >= 0.89, which restores the term -(1/6) Var(I1) f_Bd^2 (AUC 0.894).

V._terms: Left-to-right sum; a term with 'base' has a free coefficient (base = its value in the pruning member, grid = fractions scanned, local_step = numpy arange of the dense grid), a term without enters with coefficient 1.

C.name: Pi_C

seed._why: The simplest safe Pi_S-rooted formula within 0.005 AUC of the best one that passes the path gate.

structure._why: author decision: the pruning recommends 2 Sg(L_BB, Sg(d_BB, Delta_d_BX)) + D_BX6^2/(Var(Z) Z_Bmix) (AUC 0.914); the authors kept the member of the pruning set with the same 6 descriptors and AUC >= 0.919, which restores the term -(1/3) Var(Z)^2 (AUC 0.921).

C._final_coefficients: author decision: the coefficient scan recommends (-1/2, 3, 1) (AUC 0.920, BACC 0.861, margin 0.767); the authors kept the coefficients of the pruning member, (-1/3, 2, 1), which have higher AUC, BACC and margin agreement (0.921, 0.867, 0.780).
